name: Marathi
status: MACHINE-DRAFTED. Every entry carries needs_review=true. Nothing in this catalogue has been reviewed by a person.
notes: The English report is authoritative; the Marathi rendering is a translation aid.
ASCII digits are used for every score, count, identifier and hash so values copy and paste verbatim into a case file.
Technical tokens stay in Latin script: protocol names (TLS, SMTP, IMAP, POP3, STARTTLS), standard names (RFC 8446, NIST SP 800-52r2), hash names, field names, rule ids and cipher-suite names.
Terminology below is the drafting convention; a reviewer may change any term, but should change it everywhere.

terminology.note: the engine declines to conclude; neither a pass nor a failure
whether a passive capture can show it at all
one Marathi word for both uses, as in English
